name: spendly
description: Spendly – a modern, AI-assisted personal finance tracker (React + TypeScript + Express + MongoDB).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @spendly/api" "npm run dev -w @spendly/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @spendly/api && npm run build -w @spendly/web
